doc.title: Vi Redd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999

chapter: Aunt Alma Hightower and Alton Redd
title: Father's attitude to her music career and choosing to teach
summary: After a technical aside, she says her father was unhappy about a music career; she planned to teach music, then switched.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: How is this coming across? Maybe I should ask him.
Oh I’m sure it’s coming across fine. How does it look out there?
How did he feel about you — aspirations as a career in music?

He wasn’t too happy about it. Because I really didn’t start off to have a career in music. You just were going to play something. You’re going to do music. And then by the time I got out of high school I wanted to teach music. And my first two years in college that’s what I started out to be, a music teacher, and then I switched.
